title: SeatFlow Task Event
description: Schema for Server-Sent Events (SSE) emitted during SeatFlow task lifecycle transitions. Each SSE data payload is a JSON object conforming to this schema.

eventType.description: The type of task lifecycle event. Maps directly to task state transitions.

taskId.description: Unique identifier of the task this event pertains to.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the event was emitted.

payload.description: Event-specific data. Structure varies by eventType.

status.description: Current task status after this event.

progress.description: Progress fraction (0..1). Present for TASK_PROGRESS events.

result.description: Task result payload. Present for TASK_COMPLETED events.

error.description: Error detail. Present for TASK_FAILED events.

blockedBy.description: List of task IDs blocking this task. Present for TASK_BLOCKED events.

cancelledBy.description: User or system that triggered cancellation. Present for TASK_CANCELLED events.

traceId.description: Distributed trace identifier for correlating events across services.

taskStatus.description: Task lifecycle states. Terminal states: COMPLETED, CANCELLED, FAILED.
